title.description: Change or check the stream title

t.description: Alias for !title - Change or check the stream title

game.description: Change or check the stream category/game

dstart.description: Start the timer with a specific duration

dplay.description: Resume or start the paused timer

dreset.description: Reset the timer to the configured total time

dstop.description: Stop the timer completely and hide it from overlay

dtimer.description: Manage timer: start, add or remove time

so.description: Shoutout a user showing their latest clip and profile

ruleta.description: Russian roulette: configurable chance of timing out yourself (or another user). Targeting a moderator requires the Twitch Lead Moderator role

usageExamples: !ia What is the meaning of life?

join.description: Join the active giveaway in the channel

followage.description: Shows how long you've been following the channel

rango.description: Streamer's current rank in the game being played (Game Overlays)

lp.description: Points (LP/RR/ELO) won or lost during today's stream

sesion.description: Wins and losses of today's stream

cuentas.description: Streamer's accounts in the current game and their rank

juego.description: Force the overlay game or go back to automatic (mods)

setrango.description: Manually set the visible account's rank, for games without API (mods)

rankup.description: Step the manual rank up one division (mods)

rankdown.description: Step the manual rank down one division (mods)

win.description: Add a win to today's session (mods)

loss.description: Add a loss to today's session (mods)

matchup.description: Current lane matchup according to the LoL Coach (Decatron Desktop)

build.description: Runes, spells and first items suggested by the LoL Coach

coach.description: Latest thing the LoL Coach said, or the post-game review (mods)
